about: Models allowed in this project (brief §4e, principle 3). Each records its license and whether its weights are open; open-weight models are preferred. A model is added only by a reviewed change that quotes the license line from the model's own card, and only if that license clearly allows publishing outputs under GPL-3.0. The composer offers only these; every recipe records the exact model and revision.

license_checked.by: coding agent, approved by the owner

models.notes: No separate license per voice; the repository-wide Apache-2.0 covers the voice files. Voice provenance is undocumented (ATTRIBUTION.md).
Runs through mflux (MIT) at 4-bit on Apple Silicon. The model card encourages input and output filters; a public composer should add them.

candidates.status: license line seen on the card's metadata; not yet quoted and reviewed; needs 32 GB+ or a rented GPU

excluded.reason: flux-non-commercial-license does not clearly allow publishing outputs under GPL-3.0

drafting.name: Claude (Anthropic), as Claude Code and its helper agents
drafting.use: Not used to generate any published image or audio. Drafted inputs: code, read-aloud descriptions of screens and figures, pronunciation word lists, character and location profiles, image prompts, lettering, adaptation scripts. Recorded in each affected recipe's `assist`.
